canonical_statement: Produce a permutation pi of {1,...,32} such that all 496 oriented displacement vectors (j-i, pi(j)-pi(i)) for 0<=i<j<32 are pairwise distinct. An accepted permutation is a Costas array of order 32 and resolves the positive construction question, subject to a fresh novelty audit.
success_criterion: amf.costas32.exact.v1 verifies exact permutation semantics and uniqueness of all pair displacements and accepts. Independent current-status and symmetry/duplicate review remains mandatory.
partial_progress_criterion: Retain rigorously excluded construction subclasses, materially improved conflict-search methods, and near arrays only when a predeclared mathematical reuse case exists; raw low-conflict permutations alone are not a research result.
stop_conditions: A current paper or database supplies an order-32 Costas array or proves nonexistence.
The run only reproduces historical heuristic failures without a new artifact.
The separately approved experiment budget is exhausted.
